title: Esther 4:15-16 — fast three days; 14, 15, 16 Nisan
summary: Esther 4:15-16: Esther tells Mordecai to gather the Jews of Susa and fast for her three days, night or day, before she goes to the king: "if I perish, I perish." The slide dates this as 14, 15, 16 Nisan.

text.text: 15 Then Esther sent this reply to Mordecai:

16 “Go, gather together all the Jews who are in Susa, and fast for me. Do not eat or drink for three days, night or day. I and my attendants will fast as you do. When this is done, I will go to the king, even though it is against the law. And if I perish, I perish.”

numbers.note: three days of fasting, night or day
14 Nisan — first day of the three-day fast
15 Nisan — second day of the fast
16 Nisan — third day of the fast

uncertain: The Hebrew reference header reads ד:יה-יו (yod-he, yod-vav for 15-16) as shown on the slide; transcribed exactly.
